༄༅/ /grub pa'i rgyal mo'i tshe rta dang drag dmar gyi dbang shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /grub pa'i rgyal mo'i tshe rta dang drag dmar gyi dbang shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so//

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma'i dbang bskur shin tu bsdus pa byed na/ rdul tshon nam me tog gi tshom bu lnga'i dbus su tshe gtor spyi lta bur tshe dpag med kyi sku dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang tshe zan/ tshe chang*/ mda' dar/ mchod pa sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang bcas pa bshams/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril las bum sogs nyer mkho 'du bya/ skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma spyi khyab ltar byin brlabs nas bsngos la/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ sarba bidyā pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā brta ya ā brta ya hoḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas tshe dpag med kyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ padma ā sa na tiṣṭha st+waṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra pā da banda naṃ ka ro mi/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa sogs sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar gsum gyis tshogs bsags/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par bsam/ oṃ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis sbyangs/ bdag gzhan der 'dzin gyi rtog pa dngos por 'dzin pa thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ de'i ngang las sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan dang gtor ma yi ge hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim de yongs su gyur pa las/ mgon po tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po snang la rang bzhin med pa mtshan dpes brgyan pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan can rin po che sna tshogs pa'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan| mgul rgyan/ do shal/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub la sogs pa 'od 'phro bas mdzes pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs can/

phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings kyis spras pa bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a yurdzñā na sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo sogs kyis bstod/ thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'gro ba'i don byas sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi byin rlabs bsdus nas sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la thim par bsam la/ tshe gzungs/ oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzī wanti ye swā hā/ ci 'grub bzla/ las bum la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyer gcig bzla/ bdag 'jug 'og nas 'byung ba ltar ram sngags tsam gyis blang ngo*// slob ma rjes 'dzin ni/ slob ma khrus byas/ bgegs bskrad/ mdun du 'khod par thun mong gi sngon 'gros rgyud sbyangs/ maṇḍal phul nas/ lo rgyus skabs sbyar spro na bshad/ dbang gi don du/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste| |zhes pa nas/ mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/

slob ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs padma nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren cing byin dbab/ tiṣṭha badzra dang rgya gram gyis brtan par bya/ tshe dbang grub rgyal ma snga ma khungs thub rnams su tshe 'gugs med pas ma byas kyang skyon med na'ang*/ phyis rnying ma dang rigs 'dres nas tshe 'gugs byed pa'ang 'dug pas spro na/ slob dpon dang slob ma tshe dpag med gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las rgyal ba rigs lnga tshe bum dang mda' dar thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ slob ma'i sha khrag drod dbugs rnam par shes pa'i khams nas tshe 'thor yar nyams yo gas 'khyams ral zhig cing gdon bgegs kyis rkus phrog pa thams cad dang sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i bcud dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang*/ tshe la dbang ba thams cad kyi tshe'i rig 'dzin 'gro ba rigs drug gi tshe bsod dpal 'byor srog lus dbang rlung gi stobs thams cad bkug nas tshe rdzas rnams la thim par dpon slob gnyis kas dmigs shing*/ slob dpon gyis mda' dar g.yab cing*/ hūm̐ */ skal ldan rdo rje slob ma yi| |sha yi khams nas tshe nyams na// bcom ldan rin 'byung yab yum gyis// sa yi khams nas tshe khug cig /oṃ ratna a yu ṣe hūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐ */ skal ldan rdo rje slob ma yi// khrag gi khams nas tshe nyams na// bcom ldan mi bskyod yab yum gyis// chu yi khams nas tshe khug cig /oṃ badzra a yu ṣe hūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐ */ skal ldan rdo rje slob ma yi| |drod kyi khams nas tshe nyams na// bcom ldan dpag med yab yum gyis// me yi khams nas tshe khug cig /oṃ padma a yu ṣe hūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐ */ skal ldan rdo rje slob ma yi// dbugs kyi khams nas tshe nyams na// bcom ldan don grub yab yum gyis// rlung gi khams nas tshe khug cig /oṃ karma a yu ṣe hūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐ */ skal ldan rdo rje slob ma yi// rnam shes khams nas tshe nyams na// bcom ldan rnam snang yab yum gyis// nam mkha'i khams nas tshe khug cig

/oṃ buddha a yu ṣe hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes bkug /de nas dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ slob mas/ oṃ badzra a yu ṣe/ sa ra ha/ sha ra ri/ ka ra ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsol ba btab/ bla mas gtor ma thogs te/ bla ma dang gtor ma tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ phyi'i 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i khams kyi sra brtan gsher sreg g.yo ba'i rang bzhin gyi bcud dang nus pa thams cad 'od zer ser dkar dmar ljang mthing ga'i rnam par bsdus/ gtor ma tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i phyag gi bum par bkug /bum pa gang zhing lud pas bdud rtsi slob ma tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs shing thim pas/ slob ma'i sha khrag drod dbugs rnam par shes pa'i khams nas tshe nyams pa thams cad sor chud cing 'chi ba med pa tshe yi dngos grub thob par mos/ gtor ma mgor bzhag /tshe gzungs bzla/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog dor/ yang*/ bla ma dang gtor ma tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po chen po rnams dang*/ rgyal chen sde bzhi la sogs pa'i mthu stobs tshe bsod dpal 'byor thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus/ zhes pa nas/ thim par gyi bar gong bzhin la/ 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur par mos nas gong ltar dbang bskur/ yang*/ bla ma dang gtor ma sogs gong ltar la/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus zhes sogs la/ thim pas 'chi ba med pa tshe yi dngos grub sogs dang*/ dbang bskur sngar ltar bya/ slar yang gtor ma mgon po tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros/

slob ma'i dpral bar thim/ lus kyi sgo nas tshe thung ba'i las bsags pa sbyangs/ tshe dpag med kyi skur gyur/ sku'i rigs kyi 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin thob par gyur par bsam/ tshe gzungs brjod/ gtor ma mgor bzhag /yang gtor ma mgon po tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ slob ma'i mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sgo nas tshe thung ba'i las bsags pa sbyangs/ tshe dpag med kyi gsung du gyur| gsung gi rigs kyi 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin sogs tshe gzungs brjod/ gtor ma mgrin par bskur/ yang gtor ma mgon po tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros| slob ma'i snying khar thim/ yid kyi sgo nas tshe thung ba'i las bsags pa sbyangs/ tshe dpag med kyi thugs su gyur/ thugs kyi rigs kyi 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin thob par gyur/ tshe gzungs dang*/ gtor ma snying khar bskur/ yang gtor ma mgon po tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i gnas rnams nas 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros/ slob ma'i gnas rnams su thim/ sgo gsum bag med du spyad pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs/ tshe dpag med kyi sku gsung thugs su gyur/ tshe mi shigs pa rdo rje/ mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan/ mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung*/ 'chi med rdo rje'i skur gyur par bsam mo// gtor ma spyi bor bzhag /gzungs ring brjod/ tshe chang dang tshe zan sbyin/ rgyas gdab pa ni mda' dar thogs nas/ hūm̐ */ skal ldan 'chi med rdo rje la// rnam snang sangs rgyas sku yi rgya// dpag med padma gsung gi rgya// mi bskyod rdo rje thugs kyi rgya// rin chen rin 'byung yon tan rgya// don grub rgya gram phrin las rgya// mi 'gyur mi nyams rgyas btab bo// oṃ buddha badzra ratna padma karma mu dra su pra tiṣṭha rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes mda' dar gyis gnas lngar rgya gram gyi rgyas btab cing shis pa brjod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs kyis dam tshig bsrung bar khas blangs/

gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ rjes chog mchod bstod bzod gsol gshegs bsdu bsngo smon shis brjod ci rigs pa bya'o// de dag ni tshe dbang grub rgyal ma mdor bsdus pa'o/// / ༈ /yang 'di nyid nas brgyud pa'i rta mgrin gyi gtor dbang bsdus pa ni/ bca' gshom snga ma ltar la/ dpal gtor mtheb skyu bzhis bskor ba dang bdud rtsi sogs 'du bya/ cho ga snga ma kho na ltar la/ tshe dpag med zhes par rta mchog rol pa dang*/ ā yurdzñā na'i mal du ha ya grī ba zhes bsgyur/ mngon rtogs sogs sngar bzhin bsang sbyangs/ sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hrīḥdamar po las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag dang gtor ma skad cig gis khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i sku mdog dmar po spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing sma ra smin ma ag tshom ral pa'i tshogs me ltar 'bar zhing g.yo ba/ spyi gtsug tu rta mgo ljang zhur spyan gsum pa rngog ma le brgan la me 'bar zhing rta skad 'tsher ba/ rin po che dang dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas thod dbyug 'phyar zhing g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub kyis rdo rje'i zhags pa 'dzin pa brkyang bskum ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bsgyings ba'i dpral bar auṃ sogs nas mchod pa'i bar sngar ltar dang*/ hrīḥ dbang chen dregs pa 'dul ba'i gtso// dmar nag me yi 'od zer 'phro// thod dbyug zhags pa thogs pa ste// dbang mchog khro bo'i rgyal la 'dud// ces bstod/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ dregs pa can tshar bcad 'gro ba'i don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs bsdus nas sngags phreng la thim par bsam/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzla/ thun mtshams su dkar gtor chus sbyangs la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ gsum gyis byin brlabs/ a kā ro gsum gyis 'bul/ mchod bstod gtor 'bul 'di gong gi tshe chog gi skabs su'ang sbyar ro// de nas bdag 'jug blangs la/ slob ma khrus bya/ bgegs bskrad gral la bzhag /maṇḍal phul nas/ tshe dbang ltar gsol gdab rgyun bshags bya/ slob ma slar bskyed/ byin dbab/ tiṣṭha badzra dang rdo rje rgya gram gyis brtan par bya/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba mgor bzhag la/ hoḥ dbang chen dregs pa 'dul ba'i gtso// dam tshig chen po sku yi dbang*// 'bar bas slob ma'i lus sgrib sreg /ye shes rdo rje'i sku 'grub shog /oṃ ha ya grī ba hūm̐ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ de bzhin du/ hoḥ dbang chen dregs pa 'dul ba'i gtso// dam tshig chen po gsung gi dbang*// 'bar bas slob ma'i ngag sgrib sreg |ye shes rdo rje'i gsung 'grub shog /oṃ ha ya grī ba hūm̐ wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ hoḥ dbang chen dregs pa 'dul ba'i gtso// dam tshig chen po thugs kyi dbang*// 'bar bas slob ma'i yid sgrib sreg /ye shes rdo rje yid 'grub shog /oṃ ha ya grī ba hūm̐ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ sbyar bas mgrin pa dang snying khar gtad/ gsung la bdud rtsi sbyin/ slar spyi bor bzhag la/ hrīḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab// dbang chen ye shes rdo rje yis// slob ma'i sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs nas// bde chen rgyal ba'i sku 'grub shog /rtsa sngags mthar/ sarba siddhi pha la hoḥ rjes kyi bya ba rnams tshe dbang gi skabs ltar byas pas grub bo// zhes pa ni dbang chen dpa' bo gcig pa'i dbang bskur bsdus nas bshad pa'o/// / ༈ /yang bla ma drag po dmar chen nyang lugs kyi gtor dbang byed par 'dod na/ dpal gtor 'khor bzhi can dang*/ las bum sman raka sogs 'du byas/ bgegs gtor sbyin/ bde gshegs rnal 'byor rgyas pa dang*/ bdag nyid rnal 'byor dang*/ drag po thod phreng sogs kyi skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa bya/

mchod pa sman raka gtor ma rnams rang rang gi sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/ mngon rtogs ni/ bsang sbyangs/ chos dang chos nyid thams cad ni rang gi ngo bo nyid du ma grub pa'i stong pa chen po'i ngang las snang srid thams cad 'od dmar bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar zhing g.yo la 'khrugs pa 'byams klas klong chen po'i dbus su padma zla nyi rgyal bsen bsnol ba'i steng du rang rig hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ las bla ma drag po mdog dmar me yi phreng ba can khro gnyer mche gtsigs sma ra smin ma ag tshom ral pa dmar nag 'phyo zhing g.yo ba las me'i 'od phreng 'phro ba/ spyan gsum me ltar 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu pa klad la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon lcags kyi sdig pa ra gdengs pa thur du 'dzin pa/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang dar gyis brgyan pa'i zhabs brkyang bskum gyis bzhengs pa'i spyi gtsug tu me'i khyung dmar klu rigs lnga za ba/ mtshog mar rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas/ dpral bar gshin rje/ mgrin par rta mgrin/ thugs kar phyag rdor/ lte bar mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ gsang bar yaksha me dbal dang bcas pa/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas lho nub rnga yab gling nas bla ma drag po spyan drangs/ tshig bdun ma brjod/ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ a ti pū hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ arghaṃ sogs sman raka gtor ma rang sngags la/ kha raṃ khā hi/ btags pas mchod/ bstan pa ngo mtshar ma sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥhaṃ'u hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas pa'i tshe sku las rang 'dra ba'i khro bo spros/ gdon bgegs bcom/ 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sbyangs lhar byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus pa rang la bstims pas/ gzugs snang lha/ sgra grags sngags/ dran rtog thugs su bsam| slob ma rjes 'dzin ni/ bdag 'jug blangs/ slob ma khrus bya/ bgegs bskrad/ gral la bkod/ maṇḍal phul/

lo rgyus skabs sbyar bshad/ gong gi skyabs sems bya/ slob ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos dang chos nyid ces pa nas spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstim/ tshig bdun ma brjod/ tiṣṭha badzra dang rgya gram gyis brtan par bya/ gtor ma mgor bzhag /hūm̐ */ gtor snod bhandha 'bar ba ru| |dam rdzas bla ma'i sku mchog gi// oṃ dkar 'od kyis rigs kyi bu'i// lus sgrib sbyangs nas sprul sku thob// rtsa sngags mthar/ kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ zhes dpral ba dang*/ de bzhin du/ hūm̐ */ gtor snod bhandha 'bar ba ru// dam rdzas bla ma'i gsung mchog gi// āḥdamar 'od kyis rigs kyi bu'i// ngag sgrib sbyangs nas longs sku thob// rtsa sngags mthar/ wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ hūm̐ */ gtor snod bhandha 'bar ba ru// dam rdzas bla ma'i thugs mchog gi// hūm̐ mthing 'od kyis rigs kyi bu'i// yid sgrib sbyangs nas chos sku thob// rtsa sngags mthar/ tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐| zhes mgrin pa dang snying khar gtad/ mgrin pa'i dus bdud rtsi sbyin/ slar gtor ma mgor bzhag /hūm̐ */ gtor snod bhandha 'bar ba ru// dam rdzas bla ma'i ngo bo nyid// sku gsung thugs dbang yongs rdzogs nas| |dbang bzhi sku bzhi thob par shog /rtsa sngags mthar/ sarba siddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bskur/ dbang gi dag pa spyi ltar bshad/ mthar sngags lung spro na bya zhing*/ rjes su dam tshig bsrung bar khas blangs/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ rjes chog spyi 'gro ltar bya'o// de dag ni drag po dmar chen gyi dbang bskur ba'i tshul lo// smras pa/ rgyal po'i longs spyod longs spyod de// dbul po'i phye yang longs spyod nyid// blo ldan sde snod blo nor te// blo dman rnams kyang 'di nor te// de phyir blo dman 'ga' 'ga' la// phan phyir dbur stod 'bri gung pa// chos kyi grags pas bsdus te bris// zhes pa'ang long po bkra shis bde chen gyi sgrub sde'i zhal snga nas phun tshogs 'phel gyis bskul ba'i ngor/
'bri gung pa skya min ser min gyis dpal 'bri gung du sbyar ba dag go// //maṅga laṃ//
